dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Alright, I managed to get the intel through. Glad I didn't run into any trouble on the way this time!

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Heh, where do I even start... I've run into bandit and monster attacks, that sort of thing, when running intel at night... While things are generally manageable in the day, it can get really tricky on the road once it gets dark.

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: And that's after accounting for the fact that someone as experienced as I am would already know the safest routes to take...

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: But often, when there's absolutely no time to lose, we have to take the riskier option... In which case, it's entirely down to luck.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't you have more efficient ways of conveying intel?

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Well, we recently heard that those guys from up north have invented some new tech that lets you send messages over long distances.

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: We snagged a unit from the market in Nasha Town, but found it too impractical for use in combat.

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: On the field, even the most sophisticated tech or mechanisms won't save you. The only ones you should rely on are the humans.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Vlaicu, have you delivered that report to HQ?

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Of course, sir. In fact, I took this shortcut that almost no one else knows, and managed to complete the return trip in just a third of the usual time.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Glad it all went smoothly. Any instructions from the old man after you turned in the report?

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Ahem. To quote him verbatim... "If you people had told me this earlier, I'd have sent in a team disguised as treasure hunters to raid the lair of those meddling Fatui in the night."

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I figured he'd say... And that's why I decided to report the matter only after it was settled.

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Alright. You be careful out there.
